grains.RAW.STATIONS: one assembly station per ID; 24 synthetic stations (body weld cells, paint booths, trim and chassis stations, end-of-line test cells) in six Thai plant cities, with HASH-seeded age, type, reliability, shift and PM profile
grains.RAW.SENSOR_READINGS: one station-day per ENTITY_ID and EVENT_DATE; daily twin aggregates, not individual sensor packets
grains.RAW.SPARE_PARTS: one required lineside spare type per station at snapshot date
grains.CURATED.PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY: one station over the entire 90-day observation window
grains.CURATED.TREND_ANALYSIS: one day over all stations in the plant network
grains.ML.FAILURE_RISK_SCORES: one station scored on its latest observation day
grains.RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY: one station reading (simulated) loaded by Snowpipe or APP.SIMULATE_TELEMETRY
grains.ML.VIBRATION_ANOMALIES: one station-day in the last 15 days, scored against the prior 75-day baseline

mtbf_hours.zero_failures: null; not an infinite or zero MTBF estimate

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day plant-network line-stop hours FORECAST; vibration ANOMALY_DETECTION per station (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.STATION_SOP_SEARCH over 15 synthetic line-stop SOPs (one per station type and stop cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: semantic view APP.ASSEMBLY_TWIN_ANALYTICS (unplanned line stops sum to the KPI) and Cortex Agent APP.ASSEMBLY_TWIN_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; action memo by Cortex AI_COMPLETE (Snowflake build) or Amazon Bedrock Claude via external-access UDF APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE (AWS build)
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (station count, daily availability, line-stop hours by station, line-stop risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.line_stop_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of an unplanned line stop in the next 7 days, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout against the base rate
